shared_elements: figures arranged in a horizontal row
a boat or vessel form (canoe in A, ship with crew-strokes in B)
linear framing line across the composition
justification: Both surfaces depict human figures in a row and something boat-like plus a disc motif, but these are generic categories rather than shared specific forms: A shows elaborately costumed, seated and kneeling personages in profile with headdresses, offerings and a central tree, densely packed within an ornate scrolled border, while B shows a handful of tiny stick-like frontal figures with raised arms and splayed fingers scattered over open ground with a simple keel-and-crew ship. The manner of depiction is utterly different — dense, naturalistically detailed, fully framed narrative composition versus sparse, silhouette-schematic figures with no frame — so nothing suggests a shared iconographic tradition.
